comments.value: This might be due to wrong system time. If you use automatic time via network, you might want to set a different NTP server than microsofts. There also seems to be a weird bug in Windows, that has the time change, when you have hibernation/standby enabled. I'd suggest trying to disable this via console.
Thank you for reporting this issue. However, since the post is quite old and hasn't been updated recently, we encourage you to create a new ticket if the problem still persists.
